prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: []
1: ["Welcome to Your Desktop Companion", "Learn how to interact, minimize, and chat with your desktop pet before starting.", "Click pet to chat | Drag to move | Right-click to hide"]
2: ["Craft Your Desktop Pet", "Select traits and preview your companion in real time before finalizing adoption."]
3: ["Signing into your existing account automatically restores all previously created pets and companion settings."]
4: ["Choose How You Want to Meet Your Pet", "Pick a ready-to-play standard companion or create a custom pet from your photos."]
5: ["Preparing desktop environment and placing your companion on screen..."]
6: ["Desktop Pet Controls Walkthrough", "Learn how to trigger actions, hide the pet to your system tray, and adjust companion audio settings."]
7: ["Sign In to Keep Your Pet Safe", "Log in with your existing account to restore previous pets, or create a new account to sync across devices."]
8: ["Select Your Adoption Journey", "Compare pre-built instant companions vs. custom AI-generated pets side by side."]
9: ["Personality Unlocked: Energetic Explorer"]
